acceptance_criteria.statement: Legacy normalization encountering competing content or state heads stops before deleting independently authored files; no timestamp or current-source match chooses a winner.
After an author explicitly preserves and combines competing legacy content in Git, normalization produces one current record; Git retains both branches and their prior content.

content.statement: As a developer resolving legacy competing story heads, I can preserve and combine their content explicitly in Git before normalization so no independently authored intent disappears.
content.title: Resolve legacy ambiguity without losing authored content
